title.zh: 卷一百九十四下 列傳第一百四十四下: 突厥下
title.raw: 卷一百九十四下 列傳第一百四十四下: 突厥下 Volume 194 Biographies 144: Tujie 2

sentences.zh: 西突厥本與北突厥同祖。

translations.literal: The Western Turks were originally of the same ancestry as the Northern Turks.
translations.idiomatic: The Western Turks shared a common ancestry with the Northern Turks.

sentences.zh: 初，木桿與沙缽略可汗有隙，因分為二。

translations.literal: At first Mughan and Qaghan Shebolü had a rift, and therefore they split into two.
translations.idiomatic: Early on, Mughan and Qaghan Shebolü fell out, and the Turks divided into two realms.

sentences.zh: 其國即烏孫之故地，東至突厥國，西至雷翥海，南至疏勒，北至瀚海，在長安北七千里。

translations.literal: Their state was on the former lands of the Wusun; east to the Turk state, west to Lake Issyk-Kul, south to Shule, north to the Hanhai Sea, seven thousand li north of Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: Their realm occupied the old Wusun territory: east to the Turk domains, west to Issyk-Kul, south to Shule, north to the Hanhai, some seven thousand li north of Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 自焉耆國西北七日行，至其南庭；

translations.literal: From Yanqi, seven days' travel northwest reached their southern court;
translations.idiomatic: From Yanqi, seven days' travel to the northwest brought one to their southern court;

sentences.zh: 又正北八日行，至其北庭。

translations.literal: and eight days' travel due north reached their northern court.
translations.idiomatic: and eight days due north brought one to their northern court.

sentences.zh: 鐵勒、龜茲及西域諸胡國，皆歸附之。

translations.literal: The Tiele, Kucha, and all the Hu states of the Western Regions submitted to them.
translations.idiomatic: The Tiele, Kucha, and the other Hu states of the Western Regions all submitted to them.

sentences.zh: 其人雜有都陸及弩失畢、歌邏祿、處月、處密，伊吾等諸種。

translations.literal: Their people were a mixture of many clans, including the Dulu, Nushibi, Qarluq, Chuyue, Chumi, and Yiwu.
translations.idiomatic: Their people comprised a mixture of clans, among them the Dulu, Nushibi, Qarluq, Chuyue, Chumi, Yiwu, and others.

sentences.zh: 風俗大抵與突厥同，唯言語微差。

translations.literal: Their customs were on the whole the same as those of the Turks, only their speech differed slightly.
translations.idiomatic: Their customs were largely the same as those of the Turks, though their speech differed slightly.

sentences.zh: 其官有葉護，有特勒，常以可汗子弟及宗族為之；

translations.literal: Their offices included yabghu and tegin, usually filled by sons and kinsmen of the qaghan;
translations.idiomatic: Among their offices were yabghu and tegin, usually held by the qaghan's sons and kinsmen;

sentences.zh: 又有乙斤、屈利啜、閻洪達、頡利發、吐屯、俟斤等官，皆代襲其位。

translations.literal: there were also the offices of irkin, qulichuo, yan hongda, irbili, tutun, and irkin, all of which passed from generation to generation.
translations.idiomatic: and there were also the posts of irkin, qulichuo, yan hongda, irbili, tutun, and irkin, all inherited in succession.

sentences.zh: 處羅可汗，隋煬帝大業中與其弟闕達設及特勒大奈入朝。

translations.literal: Qaghan Choru, in the Daye era of Emperor Yang of Sui, came to court with his younger brother Quetuo She and Tegin Dana.
translations.idiomatic: Qaghan Choru, during the Daye reign of Emperor Yang of Sui, came to court with his younger brother Quetuo She and Tegin Dana.

sentences.zh: 仍從煬帝征高麗，賜號為曷薩那可汗。

translations.literal: He also followed Emperor Yang on the campaign against Goguryeo and was granted the title Yisana Qaghan.
translations.idiomatic: He also accompanied Emperor Yang on the campaign against Goguryeo and was granted the title Yisana Qaghan.

sentences.zh: 遇江都之亂，從宇文化及至河北。

translations.literal: When the turmoil at Jiangdu broke out, he followed Yuwen Huaji to Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: When the upheaval at Jiangdu erupted, he followed Yuwen Huaji to Hebei.

sentences.zh: 化及敗，歸長安，高祖為之降榻，引與同坐，封歸義郡王。

translations.literal: When Huaji was defeated, he returned to Chang'an; Gaozu lowered his couch for him, drew him to sit together, and enfeoffed him as Prince of Guiyi commandery.
translations.idiomatic: After Huaji's defeat, he returned to Chang'an. Gaozu had a couch lowered for him, seated him beside himself, and enfeoffed him as Prince of Guiyi commandery.

sentences.zh: 獻大珠於高祖。

translations.literal: He presented a great pearl to Gaozu.
translations.idiomatic: He presented a great pearl to Gaozu.

sentences.zh: 高祖勞之曰：「珠信為寶，朕所重者赤心，珠無所用。

translations.literal: Gaozu comforted him, saying, "A pearl is indeed a treasure, but what I value is a loyal heart; the pearl is of no use to me.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu reassured him, saying, "A pearl is indeed a treasure, but what I value is loyalty of heart; the pearl is of no use to me.

sentences.zh: 」竟不受之。

translations.literal: " In the end he did not accept it.
translations.idiomatic: " In the end he would not accept it.

sentences.zh: 先與始畢有隙，及在京師，始畢遣使請殺之，高祖不許。

translations.literal: He had earlier been at odds with Shibi; when he was in the capital, Shibi sent envoys asking that he be killed, but Gaozu would not allow it.
translations.idiomatic: He had earlier been at odds with Shibi; while he was in the capital, Shibi sent envoys requesting his execution, but Gaozu refused.

sentences.zh: 群臣諫曰：「今若不與，則是存一人而失一國也，後必為患。

translations.literal: The ministers remonstrated, saying, "If we do not grant this now, we shall preserve one man and lose a whole state; later he will surely become a scourge.
translations.idiomatic: The ministers remonstrated, saying, "If we refuse now, we shall save one man and lose a whole state; he will surely become a scourge hereafter.

sentences.zh: 」太宗曰：「人窮來歸我，殺之不義。

translations.literal: " Taizong said, "When a man in distress comes to submit to us, to kill him is unjust.
translations.idiomatic: " Taizong said, "When a man in distress comes to submit to us, to kill him would be unjust.

sentences.zh: 」驟諫於高祖，由是遲回者久之。

translations.literal: " He remonstrated repeatedly with Gaozu, and for this reason Gaozu hesitated for a long time.
translations.idiomatic: " He pressed his remonstrance upon Gaozu again and again, and for this reason Gaozu hesitated for a long time.

sentences.zh: 不得已，乃引曷薩那於內殿，與之縱酒，既而送至中書省，縱北突厥使殺之。

translations.literal: Having no choice, he then led Yisana into the inner hall, drank freely with him, and afterward sent him to the Secretariat, allowing the Northern Turk envoys to kill him.
translations.idiomatic: Left with no choice, he led Yisana into the inner hall and drank freely with him, then sent him to the Secretariat and allowed the Northern Turk envoys to kill him.

sentences.zh: 太宗即位，令以禮改葬。

translations.literal: When Taizong took the throne, he ordered that he be reburied according to ritual.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong came to the throne, he ordered a proper reburial.

sentences.zh: 闕達設初居於會寧，有部落三千余騎。

translations.literal: Quetuo She at first dwelt at Huining and had a tribe of more than three thousand horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: Quetuo She had first settled at Huining with a tribe of more than three thousand horsemen.

sentences.zh: 至隋末，自稱闕達可汗。

translations.literal: By the end of Sui he styled himself Qaghan Quetuo.
translations.idiomatic: By the end of the Sui dynasty he styled himself Qaghan Quetuo.

sentences.zh: 武德初，遣使內屬，拜吐烏過拔闕可汗，厚加撫慰。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Wude he sent envoys to submit inwardly and was appointed Qaghan Tuwuoguo Ba; he was treated with generous reassurance.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Wude era he sent envoys to submit to the court and was appointed Qaghan Tuwuoguo Ba, receiving generous reassurance.

sentences.zh: 尋為李軌所滅。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was destroyed by Li Gui.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon destroyed by Li Gui.

sentences.zh: 特勒大奈，隋大業中與曷薩那可汗同歸中國。

translations.literal: Tegin Dana, in the Daye era of Sui, returned to China together with Qaghan Yisana.
translations.idiomatic: Tegin Dana, during the Daye reign of Sui, returned to China together with Qaghan Yisana.

sentences.zh: 及從煬帝討遼東，以功授金紫光祿大夫。

translations.literal: When he followed Emperor Yang on the campaign against Liaodong, he was appointed Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon for his merit.
translations.idiomatic: When he followed Emperor Yang on the Liaodong campaign, he was appointed Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon for his service.

sentences.zh: 後分其部落於樓煩。

translations.literal: Later his tribe was settled at Loufan.
translations.idiomatic: Later his tribe was settled at Loufan.

sentences.zh: 會高祖舉兵，大奈率其眾以從。

translations.literal: When Gaozu raised his army, Dana led his followers to join him.
translations.idiomatic: When Gaozu raised his army, Dana led his followers to join him.

sentences.zh: 隋將桑顯和襲義軍於飲馬泉，諸軍多已奔退，大奈將數百騎出顯和後，掩其不備，擊，大破之，諸軍復振。

translations.literal: The Sui general Sang Xianhe attacked the righteous army at Yinma Spring; most of the armies had already fled, but Dana led several hundred horsemen out behind Xianhe, took him unawares, struck, and routed him greatly; the armies rallied again.
translations.idiomatic: The Sui general Sang Xianhe attacked the loyalist army at Yinma Spring; most units had already broken and fled, but Dana led several hundred horsemen around behind Xianhe, took him by surprise, and routed him decisively, restoring the army's morale.

sentences.zh: 拜光祿大夫。

translations.literal: He was appointed Grand Master for Splendid Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed Grand Master for Splendid Happiness.

sentences.zh: 及平京城，以力戰功，賞物五千段，賜姓史氏。

translations.literal: When the capital was pacified, for his merit in fierce fighting he was rewarded with five thousand bolts of goods and granted the surname Shi.
translations.idiomatic: When the capital was pacified, he was rewarded with five thousand bolts of goods for his valor in battle and granted the surname Shi.

sentences.zh: 武德初，從太宗破薛舉。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Wude he followed Taizong in defeating Xue Ju.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Wude era he followed Taizong in defeating Xue Ju.

sentences.zh: 又從平王世充，破竇建德、劉黑闥，並有殊功。

translations.literal: He also followed in pacifying Wang Shichong and in defeating Dou Jiande and Liu Heita, all with outstanding merit.
translations.idiomatic: He also took part in pacifying Wang Shichong and in defeating Dou Jiande and Liu Heita, distinguishing himself in each campaign.

sentences.zh: 賜宮女三人，雜彩萬余段。

translations.literal: He was granted three palace women and more than ten thousand bolts of variegated silks.
translations.idiomatic: He was granted three palace women and more than ten thousand bolts of variegated silks.

sentences.zh: 貞觀三年，累遷右武衛大將軍、檢校豐州都督，封竇國公，實封三百戶。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhenguan he was promoted in succession to General-in-Chief of the Right Martial Guard and Acting Military Governor of Fengzhou, enfeoffed as Duke of Dou state, with a substantive fief of three hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Zhenguan he rose to General-in-Chief of the Right Martial Guard and Acting Military Governor of Fengzhou, was enfeoffed as Duke of Dou, and received a substantive fief of three hundred households.

sentences.zh: 十二年卒，贈輔國大將軍。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he died and was posthumously awarded the title General Who Assists the State.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the twelfth year and was posthumously awarded the title General Who Assists the State.

sentences.zh: 初，曷薩那之朝隋也，為煬帝所拘，其國人遂立薩那之叔父，曰射匱可汗。

translations.literal: At first, when Yisana went to court at Sui, he was detained by Emperor Yang; his countrymen thereupon set up Yisana's uncle, called Qaghan Shegui.
translations.idiomatic: When Yisana had gone to the Sui court, Emperor Yang detained him; his people thereupon set up Yisana's uncle as Qaghan Shegui.

sentences.zh: 射匱可汗者，達頭可汗之孫也。

translations.literal: Qaghan Shegui was a grandson of Qaghan Datou.
translations.idiomatic: Qaghan Shegui was a grandson of Qaghan Datou.

sentences.zh: 既立後，始開土宇，東至金山，西至海，自玉門已西諸國皆役屬之。

translations.literal: After he was established, he first opened up territory; east to the Altai, west to the sea, and all the states from Yumen westward were subject to and dependent on him.
translations.idiomatic: Once established, he began to expand his domain: east to the Altai, west to the sea, and all the states from Yumen westward submitted to his rule.

sentences.zh: 遂與北突厥為敵，乃建庭於龜茲北三彌山，尋卒。

translations.literal: He then became an enemy of the Northern Turks and established his court north of Kucha at Mount Sanmi; soon afterward he died.
translations.idiomatic: He then became a rival of the Northern Turks and established his court north of Kucha at Mount Sanmi; he died soon afterward.

sentences.zh: 弟統葉護可汗代立。

translations.literal: His younger brother Qaghan Tongyehu succeeded in his place.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Qaghan Tongyehu succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 統葉護可汗，勇而有謀，善攻戰。

translations.literal: Qaghan Tongyehu was brave and resourceful and skilled in attack and battle.
translations.idiomatic: Qaghan Tongyehu was brave and resourceful and skilled in warfare.

sentences.zh: 遂北並鐵勒，西拒波斯，南接罽賓，悉歸之。

translations.literal: He then united the Tiele in the north, held Persia at bay in the west, and linked with Kapisa in the south; all submitted to him.
translations.idiomatic: He then absorbed the Tiele in the north, held Persia at bay in the west, and extended his reach to Kapisa in the south; all submitted to him.

sentences.zh: 控弦數十萬，霸有西域，據舊烏孫之地。

translations.literal: He commanded several hundred thousand bowmen, dominated the Western Regions, and held the old lands of the Wusun.
translations.idiomatic: He commanded several hundred thousand bowmen, dominated the Western Regions, and held the old Wusun lands.

sentences.zh: 又移庭於石國北之千泉。

translations.literal: He also moved his court to the Thousand Springs north of Shiguo.
translations.idiomatic: He also moved his court to the Thousand Springs north of Shiguo.

sentences.zh: 其西域諸國王悉授頡利發，並遣吐屯一人監統之，督其征賦。

translations.literal: All the kings of the Western Region states were appointed irbili, and one tutun was sent to each to supervise and oversee their levies and tribute.
translations.idiomatic: All the kings of the Western Region states were appointed irbili, and a tutun was sent to each to supervise the collection of levies and tribute.

sentences.zh: 西戎之盛，未之有也。

translations.literal: Never had the Western Rong been so powerful.
translations.idiomatic: The Western Rong had never known such power.

sentences.zh: 武德三年，遣使貢條支巨卵。

translations.literal: In the third year of Wude he sent envoys presenting a great egg from Tiaozhi.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Wude he sent envoys presenting a great egg from Tiaozhi.

sentences.zh: 時北突厥作患，高祖厚加撫結，與之並力以圖北蕃，統葉護許以五年冬。

translations.literal: At that time the Northern Turks were causing trouble; Gaozu treated him generously and won him over, planning with him to join forces against the northern frontier; Tongyehu promised the winter of the fifth year.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Northern Turks were raiding the frontier; Gaozu treated him generously and won his alliance for a joint campaign against the north. Tongyehu promised to act in the winter of the fifth year.

sentences.zh: 大軍將發，頡利可汗聞之，大懼，復與統葉護通和，無相征伐。

translations.literal: When the great army was about to set out, Qaghan Jieli heard of it and was greatly afraid; he renewed friendly relations with Tongyehu, and there was no mutual campaigning.
translations.idiomatic: When the great army was about to march, Qaghan Jieli heard of it and was greatly alarmed; he renewed friendly relations with Tongyehu, and neither side attacked the other.

sentences.zh: 統葉護尋遣使來請婚。

translations.literal: Tongyehu soon sent envoys to request a marriage alliance.
translations.idiomatic: Tongyehu soon sent envoys to request a marriage alliance.

sentences.zh: 高祖謂侍臣曰：「西突厥去我懸遠，急疾不相得力，今請婚，其計安在？

translations.literal: Gaozu said to his attendant ministers, "The Western Turks are far from us and cannot lend aid in an emergency; now they request marriage—what is their plan?
translations.idiomatic: Gaozu said to his attendant ministers, "The Western Turks are far from us and cannot lend aid in an emergency; now they request marriage—what is their plan?

sentences.zh: 」封德彜對曰：「當今之務，莫若遠交而近攻，正可權許其婚，以威北狄。

translations.literal: " Feng Deyi replied, "The task of the present age is none other than to befriend those far off and attack those near; we may properly grant the marriage for the moment, to overawe the northern barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: " Feng Deyi replied, "Our present task is to befriend those far off and attack those near; we may properly grant the marriage for the moment, to overawe the northern barbarians.

sentences.zh: 待之數年後，中國盛全，徐思其宜。

translations.literal: After several years, when China is flourishing and complete, we may slowly consider what is fitting.
translations.idiomatic: After several years, when China is flourishing and secure, we may consider what is fitting.

sentences.zh: 」高祖遂許之婚，令高平王道立至其國，統葉護大悅。

translations.literal: " Gaozu thereupon granted the marriage and sent Prince of Gaoping Li Daoli to his state; Tongyehu was greatly pleased.
translations.idiomatic: " Gaozu thereupon granted the marriage and sent Prince of Gaoping Li Daoli to his realm; Tongyehu was greatly pleased.

sentences.zh: 遇頡利可汗頻歲入寇，西蕃路梗，由是未果為婚。

translations.literal: But Qaghan Jieli raided year after year, and the roads to the western frontier were blocked; for this reason the marriage was not carried through.
translations.idiomatic: But Qaghan Jieli raided year after year, blocking the roads to the west, and the marriage was never concluded.

sentences.zh: 貞觀元年，遣真珠統俟斤與高平王道立來獻萬釘寶鈿金帶，馬五千匹。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhenguan he sent Zhenzhu Tong Irkin and Prince of Gaoping Li Daoli to present a gold belt studded with ten thousand nails and jewels, and five thousand horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Zhenguan he sent Zhenzhu Tong Irkin and Prince of Gaoping Li Daoli to present a gold belt studded with ten thousand nails and jewels, along with five thousand horses.

sentences.zh: 時統葉護自負強盛，無恩於國，部眾鹹怨，歌邏祿種多叛之。

translations.literal: At that time Tongyehu, relying on his strength, showed no kindness to his people; the tribes all resented him, and many of the Qarluq clans rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Tongyehu, relying on his power, showed no kindness to his people; the tribes resented him, and many Qarluq clans rebelled.

sentences.zh: 頡利可汗不悅中國與之和親，數遣兵入寇，又遣人謂統葉護曰：「汝若迎唐家公主，要須經我國中而過。

translations.literal: Qaghan Jieli was displeased that China had made peace with him through marriage and repeatedly sent troops to raid; he also sent someone to say to Tongyehu, "If you welcome a Tang princess, you must pass through my territory.
translations.idiomatic: Qaghan Jieli resented China's marriage alliance with him and repeatedly sent troops to raid; he also sent word to Tongyehu, saying, "If you welcome a Tang princess, you must pass through my territory.

sentences.zh: 」統葉護患之，未克婚。

translations.literal: " Tongyehu was troubled by this and could not complete the marriage.
translations.idiomatic: " Troubled by this, Tongyehu could not complete the marriage.

sentences.zh: 為其伯父所殺而自立，是為莫賀咄侯屈利俟毗可汗。

translations.literal: He was killed by his paternal uncle, who set himself up in his place; this was Qaghan Moheduo Hou Quli Sipi.
translations.idiomatic: His paternal uncle killed him and seized power; this was Qaghan Moheduo Hou Quli Sipi.

sentences.zh: 太宗聞統葉護之死，甚悼之，遣賫玉帛至其死所祭而焚之。

translations.literal: When Taizong heard of Tongyehu's death, he mourned deeply and sent jade and silks to the place of his death to sacrifice and burn them.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong heard of Tongyehu's death, he mourned deeply and sent jade and silks to the place of his death for sacrifice and burning.

sentences.zh: 會其國亂，不果至而止。

translations.literal: But his state was in disorder, and the mission did not reach there and was halted.
translations.idiomatic: But his realm was in turmoil, and the mission never reached its destination.

sentences.zh: 莫賀咄侯屈利俟毗可汗，先分統突厥種類為小可汗，及此自稱大可汗，國人不附。

translations.literal: Qaghan Moheduo Hou Quli Sipi had earlier divided the Turk clans and ruled them as minor qaghans; when he now styled himself great qaghan, his people would not submit to him.
translations.idiomatic: Qaghan Moheduo Hou Quli Sipi had earlier divided the Turk clans among minor qaghans; when he now styled himself great qaghan, his people would not submit.

sentences.zh: 弩失畢部共推泥孰莫賀設為可汗，泥孰不從。

translations.literal: The Nushibi tribes jointly urged Mohe She Nishi to become qaghan, but Nishi would not accept.
translations.idiomatic: The Nushibi tribes jointly urged Mohe She Nishi to become qaghan, but Nishi refused.

sentences.zh: 時統葉護之子咥力特勒避莫賀咄之難，亡在康居，泥孰遂迎而立之，是為乙毗缽羅肆葉護可汗。

translations.literal: At that time Tongyehu's son Tegin Dilili, fleeing Moheduo's persecution, was in exile in Kangju; Nishi thereupon welcomed him and set him up; this was Qaghan Yibibo Boluo Siyehu.
translations.idiomatic: Tongyehu's son Tegin Dilili, fleeing Moheduo's persecution, had taken refuge in Kangju; Nishi welcomed him and set him up as Qaghan Yibibo Boluo Siyehu.

sentences.zh: 連兵不息，俱遣使來朝，各請婚於我。

translations.literal: They fought without cease and both sent envoys to court, each requesting marriage with us.
translations.idiomatic: Fighting continued without cease; both sent envoys to court, each requesting a marriage alliance.

sentences.zh: 太宗答之曰：「汝國擾亂，君臣未定，戰爭不息，何得言婚！

translations.literal: Taizong answered them, saying, "Your state is in turmoil, ruler and ministers are unsettled, and war does not cease—how can you speak of marriage!
translations.idiomatic: Taizong answered them, saying, "Your realm is in turmoil, ruler and ministers are unsettled, and war does not cease—how can you speak of marriage!

sentences.zh: 」竟不許。

translations.literal: " In the end he did not grant it.
translations.idiomatic: " In the end he refused.

sentences.zh: 仍諷令各保所部，無相征伐。

translations.literal: He also admonished them to each keep their own tribes and not campaign against one another.
translations.idiomatic: He also admonished them to keep to their own domains and refrain from attacking one another.

sentences.zh: 其西域諸國及鐵勒先役屬於西突厥者，悉叛之，國內虛耗。

translations.literal: All the states of the Western Regions and the Tiele that had formerly been subject to the Western Turks rebelled; within the state resources were exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: All the Western Region states and Tiele tribes that had been subject to the Western Turks rebelled, leaving the realm drained.

sentences.zh: 肆葉護既是舊主之子，為眾心所歸，其西面都陸可汗及莫賀咄可汗部豪帥，多來附之。

translations.literal: Siyehu, being the son of the former ruler, was where the hearts of the masses turned; many of the tribal chieftains of the western Dulu Qaghan and of Qaghan Moheduo came to submit to him.
translations.idiomatic: As the son of the former ruler, Siyehu commanded the loyalty of the people; many chieftains of the western Dulu qaghan and of Qaghan Moheduo's tribes came to submit.

sentences.zh: 又興兵以擊莫賀咄，大敗之。

translations.literal: He also raised troops to attack Moheduo and routed him greatly.
translations.idiomatic: He also raised troops against Moheduo and routed him decisively.

sentences.zh: 莫賀咄遁於金山，尋為咄陸可汗所害，國人乃奉肆葉護為大可汗。

translations.literal: Moheduo fled to the Altai; soon afterward he was killed by Qaghan Duluo, and the people thereupon upheld Siyehu as great qaghan.
translations.idiomatic: Moheduo fled to the Altai and was soon killed by Qaghan Duluo; the people then upheld Siyehu as great qaghan.

sentences.zh: 肆葉護可汗立，大發兵北征鐵勒，薛延陀逆擊之，反為所敗。

translations.literal: When Qaghan Siyehu was established, he raised a great army to campaign north against the Tiele; the Xueyantuo met him in counterattack and in turn defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Once Qaghan Siyehu was established, he raised a great army to campaign north against the Tiele; the Xueyantuo met him in counterattack and defeated him in turn.

sentences.zh: 肆葉護性猜狠信讒，無統馭之略。

translations.literal: Siyehu was by nature suspicious, harsh, and trusting of slander; he had no strategy for ruling.
translations.idiomatic: Siyehu was suspicious and harsh by nature and prone to believe slander; he lacked the art of leadership.

sentences.zh: 有乙利可汗者，於肆葉護功最多，由是授小可汗，以非罪族滅之。

translations.literal: There was a Yili Qaghan who had rendered the greatest service to Siyehu; for this reason he was appointed minor qaghan, but on a groundless charge his clan was exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: One Yili Qaghan had rendered the greatest service to Siyehu and was appointed minor qaghan, but on a groundless charge his entire clan was exterminated.

sentences.zh: 群下震駭，莫能自固。

translations.literal: The subordinates were shaken with terror and could not hold themselves secure.
translations.idiomatic: His followers were shaken with terror and could no longer hold together.

sentences.zh: 肆葉護素憚泥孰，而陰欲圖之，泥孰遂適焉耆。

translations.literal: Siyehu had long feared Nishi and secretly wished to plot against him; Nishi thereupon went to Yanqi.
translations.idiomatic: Siyehu had long feared Nishi and secretly plotted against him; Nishi thereupon went to Yanqi.

sentences.zh: 其後沒卑達幹與突厥弩失畢二部豪帥潛謀擊之，肆葉護以輕騎遁於康居，尋卒。

translations.literal: Later Meibei Dagan and the tribal chieftains of the two Nushibi divisions of the Turks secretly plotted to attack him; Siyehu fled on light horse to Kangju and soon died.
translations.idiomatic: Later Meibei Dagan and the chieftains of the two Nushibi divisions secretly plotted against him; Siyehu fled on horseback to Kangju and died soon afterward.

sentences.zh: 國人迎泥孰於焉耆而立之，是為咄陸可汗。

translations.literal: The people welcomed Nishi at Yanqi and set him up; this was Qaghan Duluo.
translations.idiomatic: The people welcomed Nishi at Yanqi and set him up as Qaghan Duluo.

sentences.zh: 咄陸可汗泥孰者，亦稱大渡可汗。

translations.literal: Qaghan Duluo, Nishi, was also called Qaghan Dadu.
translations.idiomatic: Qaghan Duluo, whose personal name was Nishi, was also known as Qaghan Dadu.

sentences.zh: 父莫賀設，本隸統葉護。

translations.literal: His father was Mohe She, who had originally been subordinate to Tongyehu.
translations.idiomatic: His father Mohe She had originally been subordinate to Tongyehu.

sentences.zh: 武德中，嘗至京師。

translations.literal: In the Wude era he once came to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: During the Wude era he once came to the capital.

sentences.zh: 時太宗居籓，務加懷輯，與之結盟為兄弟。

translations.literal: At that time Taizong was in his princely domain and treated him with special care, forming a brotherhood alliance with him.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Taizong was still a prince and treated him with special care, forming a brotherhood alliance with him.

sentences.zh: 既被推為可汗，遣使詣闕請降。

translations.literal: Once he was acclaimed as qaghan, he sent envoys to the court to request submission.
translations.idiomatic: Once he was acclaimed as qaghan, he sent envoys to court to request submission.

sentences.zh: 太宗遣使賜以名號及鼓纛。

translations.literal: Taizong sent envoys granting him a title and drums and banners.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong sent envoys granting him a title along with drums and banners.

sentences.zh: 貞觀七年，遣鴻臚少卿劉善因至其國，冊授為吞阿婁拔奚利邲咄陸可汗。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Zhenguan he sent Vice Minister of the Court of Diplomatic Reception Liu Shanyin to his state to invest him as Qaghan Tun Alubo Xili Bing Duluo.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Zhenguan he sent Vice Minister of the Court of Diplomatic Reception Liu Shanyin to his realm to invest him as Qaghan Tun Alubo Xili Bing Duluo.

sentences.zh: 明年，泥孰卒，其弟同娥設立，是為沙缽羅咥利失可汗。

translations.literal: The following year Nishi died; his younger brother Tong'e She succeeded; this was Qaghan Sheboluo Xielishi.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Nishi died; his younger brother Tong'e She succeeded him as Qaghan Sheboluo Xielishi.

sentences.zh: 沙缽羅咥利失可汗，以貞觀九年上表請婚，獻馬五百疋。

translations.literal: Qaghan Sheboluo Xielishi, in the ninth year of Zhenguan, submitted a memorial requesting marriage and presented five hundred horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Zhenguan, Qaghan Sheboluo Xielishi submitted a memorial requesting marriage and presented five hundred horses.

sentences.zh: 朝廷唯厚加撫慰，未許其婚。

translations.literal: The court only treated him generously with reassurance and did not grant the marriage.
translations.idiomatic: The court treated him generously but did not grant the marriage.

sentences.zh: 俄而其國分為十部，每部令一人統之，號為十設。

translations.literal: Soon afterward his state was divided into ten divisions, each put under one man to rule it; they were called the Ten Shad.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward his realm was divided into ten divisions, each placed under a single leader; they were called the Ten Shad.

sentences.zh: 每設賜以一箭，故稱十箭焉。

translations.literal: Each shad was granted one arrow; therefore they were called the Ten Arrows.
translations.idiomatic: Each shad was granted one arrow, whence the name Ten Arrows.

sentences.zh: 又分十箭為左右廂，一廂各置五箭。

translations.literal: The Ten Arrows were further divided into left and right wings, each wing having five arrows.
translations.idiomatic: The Ten Arrows were further divided into left and right wings of five arrows each.

sentences.zh: 其左廂號五咄六部落，置五大啜，一啜管一箭；

translations.literal: The left wing was called the five Tulu tribes; five great chuo were appointed, each chuo governing one arrow;
translations.idiomatic: The left wing comprised the five Tulu tribes, with five great chuo appointed, each governing one arrow;

sentences.zh: 其右廂號為五弩失畢，置五大俟斤，一俟斤管一箭，都號為十箭。

translations.literal: the right wing was called the five Nushibi; five great irkin were appointed, each irkin governing one arrow; collectively they were called the Ten Arrows.
translations.idiomatic: the right wing comprised the five Nushibi, with five great irkin appointed, each governing one arrow; together they were known as the Ten Arrows.

sentences.zh: 其後或稱一箭為一部落，大箭頭為大首領。

translations.literal: Later one arrow was sometimes called one tribe, and the head of a great arrow was called the great chieftain.
translations.idiomatic: Later a single arrow came to denote a tribe, and the leader of a great arrow was called the great chieftain.

sentences.zh: 五咄六部落居於碎葉已東，五弩失畢部落居於碎葉已西，自是都號為十姓部落。

translations.literal: The five Tulu tribes dwelt east of Suyab; the five Nushibi tribes dwelt west of Suyab; from this time they were collectively called the Ten Surname Tribes.
translations.idiomatic: The five Tulu tribes dwelt east of Suyab and the five Nushibi tribes west of Suyab; from this time they were collectively known as the Ten Surname Tribes.

sentences.zh: 咥利失既不為眾所歸，部眾攜貳，為其統吐屯所襲，麾下亡散。

translations.literal: Since Xielishi was not where the masses turned, the tribes were divided in loyalty; he was attacked by his supervising tutun, and his followers fled and scattered.
translations.idiomatic: Because Xielishi lacked the people's loyalty, the tribes wavered; his supervising tutun attacked him, and his followers fled and scattered.

sentences.zh: 咥利失以左右百余騎拒之，戰數合，統吐屯不利而去。

translations.literal: Xielishi with a hundred or so horsemen on his left and right resisted him; they fought several engagements, and the supervising tutun, finding it unfavorable, withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Xielishi resisted with a hundred or so horsemen; after several engagements the supervising tutun withdrew, finding the fight unfavorable.

sentences.zh: 咥利失奔其弟步利設，與保焉耆。

translations.literal: Xielishi fled to his younger brother Buli She and together they held Yanqi.
translations.idiomatic: Xielishi fled to his younger brother Buli She, and together they held Yanqi.

sentences.zh: 其阿悉吉闕俟斤與統吐屯等召國人，將立欲谷設為大可汗。

translations.literal: His Asijie Que Irkin and the supervising tutun and others summoned the people of the state, intending to set up Yabghu Elibir as great qaghan.
translations.idiomatic: His Asijie Que Irkin, the supervising tutun, and others summoned the people, intending to set up Yabghu Elibir as great qaghan.

sentences.zh: 以咥利失為小可汗。

translations.literal: They made Xielishi minor qaghan.
translations.idiomatic: They made Xielishi minor qaghan.

sentences.zh: 統吐屯為人所殺，欲谷設兵又為其俟斤所破，咥利失復得舊地，弩失畢、處密等並歸咥利失。

translations.literal: The supervising tutun was killed by someone; Elibir's army was in turn defeated by his irkin; Xielishi recovered his old lands, and the Nushibi, Chumi, and others all returned to Xielishi.
translations.idiomatic: The supervising tutun was assassinated; Elibir's army was defeated by his irkin in turn; Xielishi recovered his old lands, and the Nushibi, Chumi, and others all returned to him.

sentences.zh: 十二年，西部竟立欲谷設為乙毗咄陸可汗。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year the western division at last set up Elibir as Qaghan Yibibo Duluo.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year the western division at last set up Elibir as Qaghan Yibibo Duluo.

sentences.zh: 乙毗咄陸可汗既立，與咥利失大戰，兩軍多死，各引去。

translations.literal: Once Qaghan Yibibo Duluo was established, he fought a great battle with Xielishi; many died on both sides, and each withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Once Qaghan Yibibo Duluo was established, he fought a great battle with Xielishi; many fell on both sides, and each army withdrew.

sentences.zh: 因與咥利失中分，自伊列河已西屬咄陸，已東屬咥利失。

translations.literal: They therefore divided the realm with Xielishi: from the Ili River west belonged to Duluo, east to Xielishi.
translations.idiomatic: They divided the realm with Xielishi: west of the Ili River belonged to Duluo, east to Xielishi.

sentences.zh: 咄陸可汗又建庭於鏃曷山西，謂為北庭。

translations.literal: Qaghan Duluo also established his court west of Mount Zhuhe and called it the Northern Court.
translations.idiomatic: Qaghan Duluo also established his court west of Mount Zhuhe, calling it the Northern Court.

sentences.zh: 自厥越失、拔悉彌、駁馬、結骨、火燅、觸水昆諸國皆臣之。

translations.literal: From Jueyueshi, Basmyl, Boma, Kirghiz, Huoxun, and Chushuikun, all the states submitted to him.
translations.idiomatic: The states from Jueyueshi, Basmyl, Boma, Kirghiz, Huoxun, and Chushuikun all submitted to him.

sentences.zh: 十三年，咥利失為其吐屯俟利發與欲谷設通謀作難，咥利失窮蹙，奔拔汗那而死。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year Xielishi, because his tutun Irbili Fa conspired with Elibir to make trouble, was driven to extremity, fled to Ferghana, and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year Xielishi's tutun Irbili Fa conspired with Elibir against him; driven to extremity, Xielishi fled to Ferghana and died there.

sentences.zh: 弩失畢部落酋帥迎咥利失弟伽那之子薄布特勒而立之，是為乙毗沙缽羅葉護可汗。

translations.literal: The tribal chieftains of the Nushibi welcomed the son of Xielishi's younger brother Gana, Bobutele, and set him up; this was Qaghan Yibibo Sheboluo Yehu.
translations.idiomatic: The Nushibi chieftains welcomed Bobutele, son of Xielishi's younger brother Gana, and set him up as Qaghan Yibibo Sheboluo Yehu.

sentences.zh: 乙毗沙缽羅葉護可汗既立，建庭於睢合水北，謂之南庭。

translations.literal: Once Qaghan Yibibo Sheboluo Yehu was established, he built his court north of the Suihe River and called it the Southern Court.
translations.idiomatic: Once Qaghan Yibibo Sheboluo Yehu was established, he built his court north of the Suihe River and called it the Southern Court.

sentences.zh: 東以伊列河為界，自龜茲、鄯善，且末、吐火羅、焉耆、石國、史國、何國、穆國、康國，皆受其節度。

translations.literal: Eastward the Ili River was the boundary; from Kucha, Shanshan, Qiemo, Tokhara, Yanqi, Shiguo, Shiguo of the Shi, Heguo, Muguo, and Kangguo, all were under his command.
translations.idiomatic: The Ili River formed the eastern boundary; Kucha, Shanshan, Qiemo, Tokhara, Yanqi, Shiguo, the Shi state, Heguo, Muguo, and Kangguo all fell under his command.

sentences.zh: 累遣使朝貢，太宗降璽書慰勉。

translations.literal: He repeatedly sent envoys with tribute to court; Taizong issued an imperial letter of comfort and encouragement.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly sent envoys with tribute to court, and Taizong issued an imperial letter of comfort and encouragement.

sentences.zh: 貞觀十五年，令左領軍將軍張大師往授焉，賜以鼓纛。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Zhenguan he ordered Left Army General Zhang Dashi to go and invest him, granting drums and banners.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of Zhenguan he ordered Left Army General Zhang Dashi to go and invest him, granting drums and banners.

sentences.zh: 於時咄陸可汗與葉護頗相攻擊。

translations.literal: At that time Qaghan Duluo and the yabghu were attacking one another considerably.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Qaghan Duluo and the yabghu were fighting one another fiercely.

sentences.zh: 會咄陸遣使詣闕，太宗諭以敦睦之道。

translations.literal: When Duluo sent envoys to court, Taizong instructed them in the way of sincere friendship.
translations.idiomatic: When Duluo sent envoys to court, Taizong instructed them in the way of sincere friendship.

sentences.zh: 咄陸於時兵眾漸強，西域諸國復來歸附。

translations.literal: At that time Duluo's troops gradually grew strong, and the states of the Western Regions again came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Duluo's forces gradually grew strong, and the Western Region states again submitted to him.

sentences.zh: 未幾，咄陸遣石國吐屯攻葉護，擒之，送於咄陸，尋為所殺。

translations.literal: Before long Duluo sent the Shiguo tutun to attack the yabghu, captured him, and sent him to Duluo, who soon killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Duluo sent the Shiguo tutun to attack the yabghu, captured him, and sent him to Duluo, who soon had him killed.

sentences.zh: 咄陸可汗既並其國，弩失畢諸姓心不服咄陸，皆叛之。

translations.literal: Once Qaghan Duluo had annexed his state, the various Nushibi clans were discontent in heart and would not submit to Duluo; all rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: Once Qaghan Duluo had annexed his rival's realm, the Nushibi clans refused to submit and all rebelled.

sentences.zh: 咄陸復率兵擊吐火羅，破之。

translations.literal: Duluo again led troops to attack Tokhara and defeated it.
translations.idiomatic: Duluo again led troops against Tokhara and defeated it.

sentences.zh: 自恃其強，專擅西域。

translations.literal: Relying on his strength, he monopolized the Western Regions.
translations.idiomatic: Relying on his strength, he dominated the Western Regions unchecked.

sentences.zh: 遣兵寇伊州，安西都護郭恪率輕騎二千自烏骨邀擊，敗之。

translations.literal: He sent troops to raid Yizhou; Protector-General of Anxi Guo Ke led two thousand light horsemen from Wugu to intercept and attack, and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: He sent troops to raid Yizhou; Protector-General of Anxi Guo Ke led two thousand light horsemen from Wugu to intercept them and won a victory.

sentences.zh: 咄陸又遣處月、處密等圍天山縣，郭恪又擊走之。

translations.literal: Duluo again sent the Chuyue, Chumi, and others to besiege Tianshan county; Guo Ke again attacked and drove them off.
translations.idiomatic: Duluo again sent the Chuyue and Chumi to besiege Tianshan county; Guo Ke again attacked and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 恪乘勝進拔處月俟斤所居之城，追奔及於遏索山，斬首千余級，降其處密之眾而歸。

translations.literal: Ke pressed his victory, advanced to capture the city where the Chuyue irkin dwelt, pursued the fugitives to Mount Esuo, beheaded more than a thousand, accepted the surrender of the Chumi masses, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Ke pressed his advantage, captured the Chuyue irkin's stronghold, pursued the fugitives to Mount Esuo, took more than a thousand heads, accepted the surrender of the Chumi, and returned.

sentences.zh: 咄陸初以泥孰啜自擅取所部物，斬之以徇；

translations.literal: At first Duluo because Nishi Chuo had on his own authority taken goods from his division, beheaded him as an example;
translations.idiomatic: At first Duluo had Nishi Chuo beheaded for taking goods from his division on his own authority, as an example to the rest;

sentences.zh: 尋為泥孰啜部將胡祿居所襲，眾多亡逸，其國大亂。

translations.literal: soon afterward he was attacked by Nishi Chuo's division commander Huluju; many fled and scattered, and his state fell into great disorder.
translations.idiomatic: soon afterward he was attacked by Nishi Chuo's division commander Huluju; many fled, and his realm fell into chaos.

sentences.zh: 貞觀十五年，部下屋利啜等謀欲廢咄陸，各遣使詣闕，請立可汗。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Zhenguan his subordinates Wuli Chuo and others plotted to depose Duluo; each sent envoys to court requesting that a qaghan be installed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of Zhenguan his subordinates Wuli Chuo and others plotted to depose Duluo; each sent envoys to court requesting the installation of a new qaghan.

sentences.zh: 太宗遣使賫璽書立莫賀咄乙毗可汗之子，是為乙毗射匱可汗。

translations.literal: Taizong sent envoys bearing an imperial letter to install the son of Qaghan Moheduo Yibi; this was Qaghan Yibibo Shegui.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong sent envoys bearing an imperial letter to install the son of Qaghan Moheduo Yibi as Qaghan Yibibo Shegui.

sentences.zh: 乙毗射匱可汗立，乃發弩失畢兵就白水擊咄陸。

translations.literal: Once Qaghan Yibibo Shegui was established, he raised Nushibi troops at Baishui to attack Duluo.
translations.idiomatic: Once Qaghan Yibibo Shegui was established, he raised Nushibi troops at Baishui to attack Duluo.

sentences.zh: 自知不為眾所附，乃西走吐火羅國。

translations.literal: Knowing he was not where the masses turned, Duluo fled west to the state of Tokhara.
translations.idiomatic: Knowing he lacked the people's support, Duluo fled west to Tokhara.

sentences.zh: 中國使人先為咄陸所拘者，射匱悉以禮資送歸長安，復遣使貢方物，請賜婚。

translations.literal: Chinese envoys who had earlier been detained by Duluo were all sent back to Chang'an with courtesy and provisions by Shegui; he again sent envoys presenting local products and requesting a marriage grant.
translations.idiomatic: Chinese envoys whom Duluo had earlier detained were all courteously sent back to Chang'an by Shegui; he again sent envoys with local products and requested a marriage alliance.

sentences.zh: 太宗許之，詔令割龜茲、於闐、疏勒、硃俱波、蔥嶺等五國為聘禮。

translations.literal: Taizong granted it and ordered that Kucha, Khotan, Shule, Zhujubo, and Congling—five states—be cut off as betrothal gifts.
translations.idiomatic: Taizong granted the request and ordered that Kucha, Khotan, Shule, Zhujubo, and Congling—five states—be given as betrothal gifts.

sentences.zh: 及太宗崩，賀魯反叛，射匱部落為其所並。

translations.literal: When Taizong died, Helu rebelled, and Shegui's tribes were absorbed by him.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong died, Helu rebelled and absorbed Shegui's tribes.

sentences.zh: 永徽二年，與其子咥運率眾西遁，據咄陸可汗之地，總有西域諸郡，建牙於雙河及千泉，自號沙缽羅可汗，統攝咄陸、弩失畢十姓。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yonghui he fled west with his son Dieyun at the head of the masses, seized the lands of Qaghan Duluo, held all the commanderies of the Western Regions, set up his headquarters at Shuanghe and the Thousand Springs, styled himself Qaghan Sheboluo, and ruled the ten surnames of Duluo and Nushibi.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yonghui he fled west with his son Dieyun, seized Qaghan Duluo's lands, held all the Western Region commanderies, established his headquarters at Shuanghe and the Thousand Springs, styled himself Qaghan Sheboluo, and ruled the ten surnames of Duluo and Nushibi.

sentences.zh: 其咄陸有五啜：一曰處木昆律啜；

translations.literal: Of the Duluo there were five chuo: first, Chumukunlu Chuo;
translations.idiomatic: The Duluo comprised five chuo: first, Chumukunlu Chuo;

sentences.zh: 二曰胡祿居闕啜，賀魯以女妻之；

translations.literal: second, Huluju Que Chuo, to whom Helu gave his daughter in marriage;
translations.idiomatic: second, Huluju Que Chuo, to whom Helu gave his daughter in marriage;

sentences.zh: 三曰攝舍提暾啜；

translations.literal: third, Shesheti Tun Chuo;
translations.idiomatic: third, Shesheti Tun Chuo;

sentences.zh: 四曰突騎施賀邏施啜；

translations.literal: fourth, Tuqishi Heluoshi Chuo;
translations.idiomatic: fourth, Tuqishi Heluoshi Chuo;

sentences.zh: 五曰鼠尼施處半啜。

translations.literal: fifth, Shunishi Chuban Chuo.
translations.idiomatic: fifth, Shunishi Chuban Chuo.

sentences.zh: 弩失畢有五俟斤：一曰阿悉結闕俟斤，最為強盛；

translations.literal: The Nushibi had five irkin: first, Asijie Que Irkin, the most powerful;
translations.idiomatic: The Nushibi had five irkin: first, Asijie Que Irkin, the most powerful;

sentences.zh: 二曰哥舒闕俟斤；

translations.literal: second, Geshu Que Irkin;
translations.idiomatic: second, Geshu Que Irkin;

sentences.zh: 三曰拔塞幹暾沙缽俟斤，四曰阿悉結泥孰俟斤；

translations.literal: third, Basaigan Tun Shebo Irkin; fourth, Asijie Nishi Irkin;
translations.idiomatic: third, Basaigan Tun Shebo Irkin; fourth, Asijie Nishi Irkin;

sentences.zh: 五曰哥舒處半俟斤。

translations.literal: fifth, Geshu Chuban Irkin.
translations.idiomatic: fifth, Geshu Chuban Irkin.

sentences.zh: 各有所部，勝兵數十萬，並羈屬賀魯。

translations.literal: Each had its own following; fit for battle were several hundred thousand soldiers; all were bound in subordination to Helu.
translations.idiomatic: Each had its own following; together they could field several hundred thousand fighting men, all bound to Helu.

sentences.zh: 西域諸國，亦多附隸焉。

translations.literal: The states of the Western Regions also largely attached themselves to him.
translations.idiomatic: Most of the Western Region states also submitted to him.

sentences.zh: 賀魯尋立咥運為莫賀咄葉護，數侵擾西蕃諸部，又進寇廷州。

translations.literal: Helu soon set up Dieyun as Moheduo Yabghu and repeatedly harassed the western frontier tribes; he also advanced to raid Tingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Helu soon set up Dieyun as Moheduo Yabghu and repeatedly raided the western frontier tribes; he also advanced against Tingzhou.

sentences.zh: 三年，詔遣左武候大將軍梁建方、右驍衛大將軍契苾何力率燕然都護所部回紇兵五萬騎討之，前後斬首五千級，虜渠帥六十余人。

translations.literal: In the third year an edict ordered Left Martial Guard General Liang Jianfang and Right Valiant Cavalry General Qibi Heli to lead fifty thousand Uyghur horsemen of the Yanran Protectorate to campaign against him; in all they beheaded five thousand and captured more than sixty chieftains.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year an edict ordered Left Martial Guard General Liang Jianfang and Right Valiant Cavalry General Qibi Heli to lead fifty thousand Uyghur horsemen of the Yanran Protectorate against him; they took five thousand heads and captured more than sixty chieftains.

sentences.zh: 四年，咄陸可汗死，其子真珠護與五弩失畢請擊賀魯，破其牙帳，斬首千余級。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Qaghan Duluo died; his son Zhenzhuhu together with the five Nushibi requested to attack Helu, smashed his headquarters, and beheaded more than a thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Qaghan Duluo died; his son Zhenzhuhu and the five Nushibi asked to attack Helu, smashed his headquarters, and took more than a thousand heads.

sentences.zh: 顯慶二年，遣右屯衛將軍蘇定方，燕然都護任雅相，副都護蕭嗣業，左驍衛大將軍、瀚海都督回紇婆閏等率師討擊，仍使右武衛大將軍阿史那彌射、左屯衛大將軍阿史那步真為安撫大使。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianqing he sent Right Garrison Guard General Su Dingfang, Yanran Protector Ren Yaxiang, Vice Protector Xiao Siye, Left Valiant Cavalry General and Hanhai Commander-in-Chief of the Uyghur Pojun, and others to lead troops in attack; he also appointed Right Martial Guard General Ashina Mishe and Left Garrison Guard General Ashina Buzhen as pacification commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xianqing he sent Right Garrison Guard General Su Dingfang, Yanran Protector Ren Yaxiang, Vice Protector Xiao Siye, Left Valiant Cavalry General and Hanhai Commander-in-Chief of the Uyghur Pojun, and others against Helu; he also appointed Right Martial Guard General Ashina Mishe and Left Garrison Guard General Ashina Buzhen as pacification commissioners.

sentences.zh: 定方行至曳咥河西，賀魯率胡祿居闕啜等二萬余騎列陣而待。

translations.literal: Dingfang reached the west bank of the Yexi River; Helu with Huluju Que Chuo and others, more than twenty thousand horsemen, drew up in battle array to await him.
translations.idiomatic: Dingfang reached the west bank of the Yexi River; Helu drew up more than twenty thousand horsemen, including Huluju Que Chuo, in battle array to await him.

sentences.zh: 定方率副總管任雅相等與之交戰，賊眾大敗，斬大首領都搭達幹等二百余人。

translations.literal: Dingfang with Vice Commander-in-Chief Ren Yaxiang and others joined battle; the rebel masses were greatly defeated, and more than two hundred great chieftains including Dutadagan were beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: Dingfang with Vice Commander-in-Chief Ren Yaxiang and others joined battle; the rebels were routed, and more than two hundred great chieftains including Dutadagan were killed.

sentences.zh: 賀魯及闕啜輕騎奔竄，渡伊麗河，兵馬溺死者甚眾。

translations.literal: Helu and the Que Chuo fled on light horse; crossing the Ili River, very many men and horses drowned.
translations.idiomatic: Helu and the Que Chuo fled on horseback; crossing the Ili River, very many men and horses drowned.

sentences.zh: 嗣業至千泉賀魯下牙之處，彌射進軍至伊麗水，處月、處密等部各率眾來降。

translations.literal: Siye reached the place of Helu's lower headquarters at the Thousand Springs; Mishe advanced to the Ili River; the Chuyue, Chumi, and other divisions each led their masses to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Siye reached Helu's lower headquarters at the Thousand Springs; Mishe advanced to the Ili River; the Chuyue, Chumi, and other divisions each led their people to surrender.

sentences.zh: 彌射又進次雙河，賀魯先使步失達幹鳩集散卒，據柵拒戰。

translations.literal: Mishe again advanced and halted at Shuanghe; Helu had earlier sent Bushidagan to gather scattered soldiers and hold a stockade to resist battle.
translations.idiomatic: Mishe advanced to Shuanghe; Helu had earlier sent Bushidagan to gather scattered troops and hold a stockade against him.

sentences.zh: 彌射、步真攻之，大潰；

translations.literal: Mishe and Buzhen attacked them and routed them greatly;
translations.idiomatic: Mishe and Buzhen attacked and routed them;

sentences.zh: 又與蘇定方攻賀魯於碎葉水，大破之。

translations.literal: they again joined Su Dingfang in attacking Helu at the Suyab River and defeated him greatly.
translations.idiomatic: they then joined Su Dingfang in attacking Helu at the Suyab River and won a great victory.

sentences.zh: 賀魯與咥運欲投鼠耨設，至石國之蘇咄城傍，人馬饑乏，城主伊涅達幹詐將酒食出迎，賀魯信其言入城，遂被拘執。

translations.literal: Helu and Dieyun wished to submit to the Shunu she; reaching beside the Sudu city of Shiguo, men and horses were hungry and exhausted; the city lord Yiniedagan falsely offered wine and food and came out to welcome them; Helu believed his words and entered the city, and was thereupon seized and held.
translations.idiomatic: Helu and Dieyun wished to submit to the Shunu she; reaching the Sudu city of Shiguo, their men and horses were starving; the city lord Yiniedagan falsely offered food and wine and came out to welcome them; Helu believed him and entered the city, where he was seized.

sentences.zh: 蕭嗣業既至石國，鼠耨設乃以賀魯屬之。

translations.literal: Once Xiao Siye had reached Shiguo, the Shunu she thereupon handed Helu over to him.
translations.idiomatic: Once Xiao Siye reached Shiguo, the Shunu she handed Helu over to him.

sentences.zh: 賀魯謂嗣業曰：「我破亡虜耳！

translations.literal: Helu said to Siye, "I am but a defeated and ruined captive!
translations.idiomatic: Helu said to Siye, "I am but a defeated captive!

sentences.zh: 先帝厚我，而我背之，今日之敗，天怒我也。

translations.literal: The late emperor treated me generously, yet I betrayed him; today's defeat is Heaven's anger at me.
translations.idiomatic: The late emperor treated me generously, yet I betrayed him; today's defeat is Heaven's judgment upon me.

sentences.zh: 舊聞漢法，殺人皆於都市，至京殺我，請向昭陵，使得謝罪於先帝，是本願也。

translations.literal: I have long heard that by Han law all executions are in the marketplaces; when you reach the capital and execute me, I beg to face Zhaoling, that I may be allowed to confess my guilt before the late emperor—that is my true wish.
translations.idiomatic: I have long heard that by Han law executions take place in the marketplace; when you reach the capital and execute me, I beg to face Zhaoling so that I may confess my guilt before the late emperor—that is my true wish.

sentences.zh: 」高宗聞而湣之。

translations.literal: " When Gaozong heard this, he pitied him.
translations.idiomatic: " When Gaozong heard this, he pitied him.

sentences.zh: 及俘賀魯至京師，令獻於昭陵及太廟，詔特免死。

translations.literal: When the captive Helu reached the capital, he was ordered presented at Zhaoling and the Imperial Ancestral Temple; an edict specially spared his life.
translations.idiomatic: When the captive Helu reached the capital, he was presented at Zhaoling and the Imperial Ancestral Temple; an edict specially spared his life.

sentences.zh: 分其種落置昆陵、濛池二都護府，其所役屬諸國，皆分置州府，西盡於波斯，並隸安西都護府。

translations.literal: His tribes and clans were divided and placed in the two protectorates of Kunling and Mengchi; the states that had been subject to him were all divided and set up as prefectures and districts; west to Persia, all were subordinate to the Protectorate-General of Anxi.
translations.idiomatic: His tribes were divided between the Kunling and Mengchi protectorates; the states that had been subject to him were organized as prefectures and districts; west to Persia, all fell under the Protectorate-General of Anxi.

sentences.zh: 四年，賀魯卒。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Helu died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Helu died.

sentences.zh: 詔葬於頡利墓側，刻石以紀其事。

translations.literal: An edict ordered him buried beside Jieli's tomb, with stone carved to record the affair.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered him buried beside Jieli's tomb, with an inscribed stone to record the affair.

sentences.zh: 阿史那彌射者，室點密可汗五代孫也。

translations.literal: Ashina Mishe was a fifth-generation descendant of Qaghan Shidianmi.
translations.idiomatic: Ashina Mishe was a fifth-generation descendant of Qaghan Shidianmi.

sentences.zh: 初，室點密從單於統領十大首領，有兵十萬眾，往平西域諸胡國，自為可汗，號十姓部落，世統其眾。

translations.literal: At first Shidianmi followed the chanyu in commanding the ten great chieftains; he had an army of one hundred thousand men, went to pacify the various Hu states of the Western Regions, set himself up as qaghan, and was called the Ten Surname Tribes, ruling their masses for generations.
translations.idiomatic: Shidianmi had followed the chanyu in commanding the ten great chieftains; with an army of one hundred thousand he pacified the Hu states of the Western Regions, set himself up as qaghan, and was called the Ten Surname Tribes, ruling their people for generations.

sentences.zh: 彌射在本蕃為莫賀咄葉護。

translations.literal: Mishe in his native land was Moheduo Yabghu.
translations.idiomatic: In his native land Mishe was Moheduo Yabghu.

sentences.zh: 貞觀六年，詔遣鴻臚少卿劉善因就蕃立為奚利邲咄陸可汗，賜以鼓纛、彩帛萬段。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Zhenguan an edict sent Vice Minister of the Court of Diplomatic Reception Liu Shanyin to his land to install him as Qaghan Xili Bing Duluo, granting drums, banners, and ten thousand bolts of colored silks.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Zhenguan an edict sent Vice Minister Liu Shanyin to his land to install him as Qaghan Xili Bing Duluo, granting drums, banners, and ten thousand bolts of colored silks.

sentences.zh: 其族兄步真欲自立為可汗，遂謀殺彌射弟侄二十余人。

translations.literal: His clansman elder brother Buzhen wished to set himself up as qaghan and therefore plotted to kill more than twenty of Mishe's younger brothers and nephews.
translations.idiomatic: His clansman Buzhen wished to set himself up as qaghan and plotted to kill more than twenty of Mishe's younger brothers and nephews.

sentences.zh: 彌射既與步真有隙，以貞觀十三年率所部處月、處密部落入朝，授右監門大將軍。

translations.literal: Mishe, being at odds with Buzhen, in the thirteenth year of Zhenguan led his Chuyue and Chumi tribes to court and was appointed General of the Right Gate Guards.
translations.idiomatic: At odds with Buzhen, Mishe led his Chuyue and Chumi tribes to court in the thirteenth year of Zhenguan and was appointed General of the Right Gate Guards.

sentences.zh: 其後步真遂自立為咄陸葉護，其部落多不服，委之遁去。

translations.literal: Afterward Buzhen set himself up as Duluo Yabghu; many of his tribes would not submit and abandoned him and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward Buzhen set himself up as Duluo Yabghu; many of his tribes refused to submit and abandoned him.

sentences.zh: 步真復攜家屬入朝，授左屯衛大將軍。

translations.literal: Buzhen again came to court with his household and was appointed Left Garrison Guard General.
translations.idiomatic: Buzhen again came to court with his household and was appointed Left Garrison Guard General.

sentences.zh: 彌射後從太宗征高麗有功，封平襄縣伯。

translations.literal: Mishe later followed Taizong on the campaign against Goguryeo with merit and was enfeoffed as Baron of Pingxiang county.
translations.idiomatic: Mishe later followed Taizong on the Goguryeo campaign with distinction and was enfeoffed as Baron of Pingxiang county.

sentences.zh: 顯慶二年，轉右武衛大將軍。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianqing he was transferred to General of the Right Martial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xianqing he was transferred to General of the Right Martial Guard.

sentences.zh: 及討平賀魯，乃冊立彌射為興昔亡可汗兼右衛大將軍、昆陵都護，分押賀魯下五咄六部落。

translations.literal: When Helu was pacified by campaign, Mishe was invested as Qaghan Xingxiwang together with General of the Right Guard and Protector of Kunling, to hold in custody the five Tulu tribes under Helu.
translations.idiomatic: When Helu was defeated, Mishe was invested as Qaghan Xingxiwang, General of the Right Guard, and Protector of Kunling, with authority over the five Tulu tribes under Helu.

sentences.zh: 步真授繼往絕可汗，兼右衛大將軍、濛池都護，仍分押五弩失畢部落。

translations.literal: Buzhen was granted Qaghan Jiwangjue, together with General of the Right Guard and Protector of Mengchi, and still held in custody the five Nushibi tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Buzhen was granted the title Qaghan Jiwangjue, General of the Right Guard, and Protector of Mengchi, with authority over the five Nushibi tribes.

sentences.zh: 因下詔曰：

translations.literal: Thereupon an edict was issued, saying:
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon an edict was issued, saying:

sentences.zh: 自西蕃罹亂，三十余年。

translations.literal: Since the western frontier suffered disorder, more than thirty years have passed.
translations.idiomatic: The western frontier has been in disorder for more than thirty years.

sentences.zh: 比者賀魯猖狂，百姓重被劫掠。

translations.literal: Recently Helu has been wanton and violent; the common people have again suffered plunder.
translations.idiomatic: Recently Helu has run riot, and the people have again suffered plunder.

sentences.zh: 朕君臨四海，情均養育。

translations.literal: We rule the four seas and in feeling treat all equally in nurture.
translations.idiomatic: We rule the four seas and nurture all alike.

sentences.zh: 不可使兇狡之虜，恣行侵漁，無辜之氓，久遭塗炭。

translations.literal: We cannot allow fierce and cunning barbarians to indulge in invasion and plunder, nor innocent common folk to long suffer ruin.
translations.idiomatic: We cannot allow fierce barbarians to plunder at will while innocent people suffer ruin.

sentences.zh: 故遣右屯衛將軍蘇定方等統率騎勇，北路討逐。

translations.literal: Therefore We have sent Right Garrison Guard General Su Dingfang and others to command cavalry valor on the northern route to pursue and expel them.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore We have sent Right Garrison Guard General Su Dingfang and others to lead cavalry on the northern route against them.

sentences.zh: 卿等宣暢朝風，南道撫育。

translations.literal: You shall spread abroad the court's influence and nurture on the southern route.
translations.idiomatic: You shall spread the court's influence and bring nurture on the southern route.

sentences.zh: 遂使兇渠畏威，夷人慕德，伐叛柔服，西域總平。

translations.literal: Thus the fierce chieftains feared Our might, the barbarians admired Our virtue, rebels were attacked and the submissive comforted, and the Western Regions were altogether pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the fierce chieftains feared Our might, the tribes admired Our virtue, rebels were crushed and the submissive comforted, and the Western Regions were pacified.

sentences.zh: 賀魯父子既已擒獲，諸頭部落須有統領。

translations.literal: Since Helu father and son have already been captured, the various tribal heads must have leaders.
translations.idiomatic: Since Helu and his son have been captured, the tribal heads must have leaders.

sentences.zh: 卿早歸闕庭，久參宿衛，深感恩義，甚知法式，所以冊立卿等各為一部可汗。

translations.literal: You long ago returned to the court, long served in the palace guard, deeply understand grace and righteousness, and know well the laws and methods; therefore We invest each of you as qaghan of one division.
translations.idiomatic: You returned to court long ago, served long in the palace guard, understand grace and duty deeply, and know the laws well; therefore We invest each of you as qaghan of one division.

sentences.zh: 但諸姓從賀魯，非其本情，卿等才至即降，亦是赤心向國。

translations.literal: Yet the various clans followed Helu not from their true hearts; when you had only just arrived they submitted—that too shows a loyal heart toward the state.
translations.idiomatic: The various clans followed Helu against their true wishes; when you arrived they submitted at once—that too shows loyalty to the state.

sentences.zh: 卿宜與盧承慶等準其部落大小，位望高下，節級授刺史以下官。

translations.literal: You should together with Lu Chengqing and others, according to each tribe's size and each man's rank high or low, grant offices step by step down to prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Lu Chengqing and others, you should grant offices according to each tribe's size and each leader's rank, down to the level of prefect.

sentences.zh: 龍朔中，又令彌射、步真率所部從釭海道大總管蘇海政討龜茲。

translations.literal: In the Longshuo era he again ordered Mishe and Buzhen to lead their divisions to follow Grand Commander Su Haizheng of the Gang Sea route in campaigning against Kucha.
translations.idiomatic: In the Longshuo era he again ordered Mishe and Buzhen to lead their divisions under Grand Commander Su Haizheng of the Gang Sea route against Kucha.

sentences.zh: 步真嘗欲並彌射部落，遂密告海政云：「彌射欲謀反，請以計誅之。

translations.literal: Buzhen had long wished to absorb Mishe's tribes; he thereupon secretly informed Haizheng, saying, "Mishe intends to rebel; please use a stratagem to execute him.
translations.idiomatic: Buzhen had long wished to absorb Mishe's tribes; he secretly informed Haizheng, saying, "Mishe intends to rebel; please use a stratagem to kill him.

sentences.zh: 」時海政兵才數千，懸師在彌射境內，遂集軍吏而謀曰：「彌射若反，我輩即無噍類。

translations.literal: " At that time Haizheng's troops were only several thousand, an isolated army within Mishe's territory; he thereupon gathered the military officers to plot, saying, "If Mishe rebels, we shall have nothing left to swallow.
translations.idiomatic: " Haizheng's troops numbered only a few thousand, an isolated force in Mishe's territory; he gathered his officers and said, "If Mishe rebels, we are all dead men.

sentences.zh: 今宜先舉事，則可克捷。

translations.literal: Now we should act first, and then we can achieve victory.
translations.idiomatic: We must strike first, and then we can prevail.

sentences.zh: 」乃偽稱有敕，令大總管賫物數百萬段分賜可汗及諸首領。

translations.literal: " He thereupon falsely claimed there was an edict ordering the Grand Commander to bring several million bolts of goods to distribute to the qaghan and various chieftains.
translations.idiomatic: " He falsely claimed an edict ordering the Grand Commander to bring several million bolts of goods to distribute to the qaghan and chieftains.

sentences.zh: 由是彌射率其麾下，隨例請物，海政盡收斬之。

translations.literal: Thereupon Mishe led his followers to request goods according to custom; Haizheng gathered them all and beheaded them.
translations.idiomatic: Mishe led his followers to claim their shares; Haizheng seized them all and executed them.

sentences.zh: 共後西蕃盛言彌射非反，為步真所誣，而海政不能審察，濫行誅戮。

translations.literal: Afterward the western frontier widely said that Mishe had not rebelled but was slandered by Buzhen, while Haizheng could not examine the matter and indiscriminately carried out executions.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward the western frontier widely held that Mishe had not rebelled but had been slandered by Buzhen, while Haizheng failed to investigate and executed him unjustly.

sentences.zh: 則天臨朝，十姓無主數年，部落多散失。

translations.literal: When Zetian held court, the ten surnames were without rulers for several years, and many tribes scattered and were lost.
translations.idiomatic: When Empress Wu held court, the ten surnames were without rulers for several years, and many tribes scattered.

sentences.zh: 垂拱初，遂擢授彌射子左豹韜衛翊府中郎將元慶為左玉鈐衛將軍兼昆陵都護，令襲興昔亡可汗，押五咄六部落。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Chuigong, Mishe's son Yuanqing, Central Commandant of the Left Leopard Bow Guard Attendant Office, was promoted and appointed Left Jade Bell Guard General and concurrent Protector of Kunling, ordered to succeed Qaghan Xingxiwang and hold in custody the five Tulu tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Chuigong era, Mishe's son Yuanqing was promoted to Left Jade Bell Guard General and concurrent Protector of Kunling, ordered to succeed Qaghan Xingxiwang and govern the five Tulu tribes.

sentences.zh: 步真子斛瑟羅為右玉鈐衛將軍，兼濛池都護，押五弩失畢部落。

translations.literal: Buzhen's son Husiluo was made Right Jade Bell Guard General and concurrent Protector of Mengchi, holding in custody the five Nushibi tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Buzhen's son Husiluo was made Right Jade Bell Guard General and concurrent Protector of Mengchi, governing the five Nushibi tribes.

sentences.zh: 尋進授元慶左衛大將軍。

translations.literal: Soon afterward Yuanqing was further appointed Left Guard General.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanqing was soon promoted to Left Guard General.

sentences.zh: 突騎施烏質勒者，西突厥之別種也。

translations.literal: Wuzhile of the Tuqishi was a separate branch of the Western Turks.
translations.idiomatic: Wuzhile of the Tuqishi was a separate branch of the Western Turks.

sentences.zh: 初隸在斛瑟羅下，號為莫賀達幹。

translations.literal: At first he was subordinate under Husiluo and was called Mohedagan.
translations.idiomatic: At first he was subordinate to Husiluo and was called Mohedagan.

sentences.zh: 後以斛瑟羅用刑嚴酷，眾皆畏之，尤能撫恤其部落，由是為遠近諸胡所歸附。

translations.literal: Later, because Husiluo's punishments were harsh and cruel, all feared him; Wuzhile was especially able to comfort and care for his tribes, and for this reason the Hu near and far submitted to him.
translations.idiomatic: Because Husiluo's punishments were harsh, all feared him; Wuzhile was especially skilled at caring for his tribes, and for this reason the Hu near and far submitted to him.

sentences.zh: 其下置都督二十員，各統兵七千人。

translations.literal: Under him were set up twenty commanders-in-chief, each commanding seven thousand soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: He appointed twenty commanders-in-chief, each commanding seven thousand soldiers.

sentences.zh: 嘗屯聚碎葉西北界，後漸攻陷碎葉，徙其牙帳居之。

translations.literal: He once gathered his forces on the northwest border of Suyab; later he gradually attacked and captured Suyab and moved his headquarters to dwell there.
translations.idiomatic: He once gathered his forces on the northwest border of Suyab; later he gradually captured Suyab and moved his headquarters there.

sentences.zh: 東北與突厥為鄰，西南與諸胡相接，東南至西廷州。

translations.literal: Northeast he bordered the Turks; southwest he connected with the various Hu; southeast to Xitingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: To the northeast he bordered the Turks; to the southwest he connected with the various Hu; to the southeast his realm reached Xitingzhou.

sentences.zh: 斛瑟羅以部眾削弱，自則天時入朝，不敢還蕃，其地並為烏質勒所並。

translations.literal: Husiluo, because his tribes were weakened, from the time of Zetian came to court and dared not return to his land; his territory was all absorbed by Wuzhile.
translations.idiomatic: Husiluo's tribes had weakened; from Empress Wu's time he came to court and dared not return; Wuzhile absorbed all his territory.

sentences.zh: 景龍二年，詔封為西河郡王，令攝御史大夫，解琬就加冊立。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jinglong an edict enfeoffed him as Prince of Xihe commandery, ordered him to act as Censor-in-Chief, and sent Jie Wan to go and invest him.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jinglong an edict enfeoffed him as Prince of Xihe commandery, ordered him to act as Censor-in-Chief, and sent Jie Wan to invest him.

sentences.zh: 未至，烏質勒卒。

translations.literal: Before he arrived, Wuzhile died.
translations.idiomatic: Before he arrived, Wuzhile died.

sentences.zh: 其長子娑葛代統其眾，詔便立娑葛為金河郡王，仍賜以宮女四人。

translations.literal: His eldest son Suoge succeeded in commanding his masses; an edict at once set up Suoge as Prince of Jinhe commandery and also granted him four palace women.
translations.idiomatic: His eldest son Suoge succeeded him; an edict at once made Suoge Prince of Jinhe commandery and granted him four palace women.

sentences.zh: 初，娑葛代父統兵，烏質勒下部將闕啜忠節甚忌之，以兵部尚書宗楚客當朝任勢，密遣使賫金七百兩以賂楚客，請停娑葛統兵。

translations.literal: At first Suoge succeeded his father in commanding troops; Wuzhile's subordinate general Quechuo Zhongjie greatly resented him; relying on Minister of War Zong Chuke's power in court, he secretly sent envoys bearing seven hundred taels of gold to bribe Chuke, requesting that Suoge be stopped from commanding troops.
translations.idiomatic: When Suoge succeeded his father in command, Wuzhile's subordinate Quechuo Zhongjie resented him; relying on Minister of War Zong Chuke's power, he secretly sent envoys with seven hundred taels of gold to bribe Chuke and have Suoge removed from command.

sentences.zh: 楚客乃遣御史中丞馮嘉賓充使至其境，陰與忠節籌其事，並自致書以申意。

translations.literal: Chuke thereupon sent Imperial Censor Feng Jiabin as envoy to his territory, secretly plotting the affair with Zhongjie, and also sent a letter himself to express his intent.
translations.idiomatic: Chuke sent Imperial Censor Feng Jiabin as envoy to his territory, secretly plotting with Zhongjie, and also sent a letter expressing his intent.

sentences.zh: 在路為娑葛遊兵所獲，遂斬嘉賓，仍進兵攻陷火燒等城，遣使上表以索楚客頭。

translations.literal: On the road he was captured by Suoge's patrol troops; Suoge thereupon beheaded Jiabin, advanced troops to attack and capture Huoshao and other cities, and sent envoys with a memorial demanding Chuke's head.
translations.idiomatic: On the road he was captured by Suoge's patrols; Suoge beheaded Jiabin, advanced to capture Huoshao and other cities, and sent envoys demanding Chuke's head.

sentences.zh: 景龍三年，娑葛弟遮弩恨所分部落少於其兄，遂叛入突厥，請為鄉導，以討娑葛。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jinglong Suoge's younger brother Zhenu resented that the tribes allotted to him were fewer than his brother's; he thereupon rebelled and entered the Turks, requesting to serve as guide to campaign against Suoge.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Jinglong Suoge's younger brother Zhenu, resenting his smaller share of tribes, rebelled and fled to the Turks, offering to guide them against Suoge.

sentences.zh: 默啜乃留遮弩，遣兵二萬人與其左右來討娑葛，擒之而還。

translations.literal: Mochuo thereupon detained Zhenu and sent twenty thousand troops with his attendants to campaign against Suoge, captured him, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Mochuo detained Zhenu and sent twenty thousand troops with his attendants against Suoge, captured him, and returned.

sentences.zh: 默啜顧謂遮弩曰：「汝於兄弟尚不和協，豈能盡心於我。

translations.literal: Mochuo turned and said to Zhenu, "You are not even in harmony with your brothers—how can you devote your heart to me?
translations.idiomatic: Mochuo turned to Zhenu and said, "You cannot even live in harmony with your brothers—how can you be loyal to me?

sentences.zh: 」遂與娑葛俱殺之。

translations.literal: " He thereupon killed both him and Suoge.
translations.idiomatic: " He then killed them both.

sentences.zh: 默啜兵還，娑葛下部將蘇祿鳩集余眾，自立為可汗。

translations.literal: When Mochuo's troops returned, Suoge's subordinate general Sulu gathered the remaining masses and set himself up as qaghan.
translations.idiomatic: When Mochuo's troops withdrew, Suoge's subordinate Sulu gathered the survivors and set himself up as qaghan.

sentences.zh: 蘇祿者，突騎施別種也。

translations.literal: Sulu was of a separate branch of the Tuqishi.
translations.idiomatic: Sulu was of a separate branch of the Tuqishi.

sentences.zh: 頗善綏撫，十姓部落漸歸附之，眾二十萬，遂雄西域之地，尋遣使來朝。

translations.literal: He was quite skilled at reassurance and pacification; the ten surname tribes gradually submitted to him; his masses were two hundred thousand; he thereupon dominated the lands of the Western Regions and soon sent envoys to court.
translations.idiomatic: Skilled at reassurance and pacification, he gradually won the ten surname tribes; his following reached two hundred thousand, and he dominated the Western Regions; he soon sent envoys to court.

sentences.zh: 開元三年，制授蘇祿為左羽林軍大將軍、金方道經略大使，進為特勒，遣侍御史解忠順賫璽書冊立為忠順可汗。

translations.literal: In the third year of Kaiyuan an edict appointed Sulu General of the Left Forest of Feathers Army and Military Commissioner of the Jinfang Circuit, promoted him to tegin, and sent Attending Censor Xie Zhongshun bearing an imperial letter to invest him as Qaghan Zhongshun.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Kaiyuan an edict appointed Sulu General of the Left Forest of Feathers Army and Military Commissioner of the Jinfang Circuit, promoted him to tegin, and sent Attending Censor Xie Zhongshun to invest him as Qaghan Zhongshun.

sentences.zh: 自是每年遣使朝獻。

translations.literal: From this time he sent envoys with tribute to court every year.
translations.idiomatic: From this time he sent tribute envoys to court every year.

sentences.zh: 上乃立史懷道女為金河公主以妻之。

translations.literal: The emperor thereupon set up the daughter of Shi Huaidao as Princess of Jinhe and gave her to him in marriage.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor gave him Shi Huaidao's daughter as Princess of Jinhe in marriage.

sentences.zh: 時杜暹為安西都護，公主遣牙官賫馬千疋詣安西互市。

translations.literal: At that time Du Xian was Protector-General of Anxi; the princess sent a yabgu officer bearing one thousand horses to Anxi for mutual trade.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Du Xian was Protector-General of Anxi; the princess sent an officer with one thousand horses to Anxi for trade.

sentences.zh: 使者宣公主教與暹，暹怒曰：「阿史那氏女，豈合宣教與吾節度耶！

translations.literal: The envoy proclaimed the princess's command to Xian; Xian angrily said, "A daughter of the Ashina clan—how is it fitting to proclaim commands to me, a frontier commander!
translations.idiomatic: The envoy proclaimed the princess's command to Xian; Xian angrily said, "A daughter of the Ashina clan—how dare she issue commands to me, a frontier commander!

sentences.zh: 」杖其使者，留而不遣，其馬經雪，寒死並盡。

translations.literal: " He flogged the envoy and detained him without sending him back; the horses, passing through snow, all died of cold.
translations.idiomatic: " He flogged the envoy and detained him; the horses, passing through snow, all perished in the cold.

sentences.zh: 蘇祿大怒，發兵分寇四鎮。

translations.literal: Sulu was greatly enraged and raised troops to raid the four garrisons in separate columns.
translations.idiomatic: Sulu was enraged and sent troops to raid the four garrisons.

sentences.zh: 會杜暹入知政事，趙頤貞代為安西都護，城守久之，由是四鎮貯積及人畜並為蘇祿所掠，安西僅全。

translations.literal: When Du Xian entered the government to manage affairs, Zhao Yizhen replaced him as Protector-General of Anxi; they held the cities in defense for a long time; thereby the stored goods, livestock, and people of the four garrisons were all plundered by Sulu, and only Anxi itself was preserved.
translations.idiomatic: When Du Xian entered the central government, Zhao Yizhen replaced him as Protector-General of Anxi; the garrisons held out for a long time, but Sulu plundered their stores, livestock, and people; only Anxi itself was preserved.

sentences.zh: 蘇祿既聞杜暹入相，稍引退，俄又遣使入朝獻方物。

translations.literal: Once Sulu heard that Du Xian had entered the chancellorship, he gradually withdrew; soon afterward he again sent envoys to court presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: Once Sulu heard that Du Xian had become chancellor, he gradually withdrew; soon afterward he again sent envoys with tribute to court.

sentences.zh: 十八年，蘇祿使至京師，玄宗禦丹鳳樓設宴。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year Sulu's envoys reached the capital; Xuanzong held a banquet at Danfeng Tower.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year Sulu's envoys reached the capital; Xuanzong held a banquet for them at Danfeng Tower.

sentences.zh: 突厥先遣使入朝，是日亦來預宴，與蘇祿使爭長。

translations.literal: The Turks had earlier sent envoys to court; that day they also came to attend the banquet and disputed precedence with Sulu's envoys.
translations.idiomatic: The Turks had earlier sent envoys to court; that day they also attended the banquet and disputed precedence with Sulu's envoys.

sentences.zh: 突厥使曰：「突騎施國小，本是突厥之臣，不宜居上。

translations.literal: The Turk envoy said, "The Tuqishi state is small and was originally a subject of the Turks; it is not fitting to sit above.
translations.idiomatic: The Turk envoy said, "The Tuqishi state is small and was originally subject to the Turks; it is not fitting to sit above us.

sentences.zh: 」蘇祿使曰：「今日此宴，乃為我設，不合居下。

translations.literal: " Sulu's envoy said, "Today's banquet was set for us; it is not fitting to sit below.
translations.idiomatic: " Sulu's envoy said, "Today's banquet was held for us; we should not sit below.

sentences.zh: 」於是中書門下及百僚議，遂於東西幕下兩處分坐，突厥使在東，突騎施使在西。

translations.literal: " Thereupon the Secretariat-Chancellery and the hundred officials deliberated and seated them in two places under the eastern and western canopies; the Turk envoys in the east, the Tuqishi envoys in the west.
translations.idiomatic: " The Secretariat-Chancellery and officials deliberated and seated them separately under the eastern and western canopies: the Turks in the east, the Tuqishi in the west.

sentences.zh: 宴訖，厚賫而遣之。

translations.literal: When the banquet ended, they were richly rewarded and sent off.
translations.idiomatic: When the banquet ended, they were richly rewarded and dismissed.

sentences.zh: 蘇祿性尤清儉，每戰伐，有所克獲，盡分與將士及諸部落。

translations.literal: Sulu's nature was especially frugal and abstemious; whenever he campaigned and gained booty, he divided it all among officers, soldiers, and the various tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Sulu was especially frugal; whenever he campaigned and gained booty, he divided it all among his officers, soldiers, and tribes.

sentences.zh: 其下愛之，甚為其用。

translations.literal: His subordinates loved him and served him devotedly.
translations.idiomatic: His followers loved him and served him devotedly.

sentences.zh: 潛又遣使南通吐蕃，東附突厥。

translations.literal: Secretly he also sent envoys south to ally with Tibet and east to attach to the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: Secretly he also allied with Tibet in the south and the Turks in the east.

sentences.zh: 突厥及吐蕃亦嫁女與蘇祿。

translations.literal: The Turks and Tibet also gave daughters in marriage to Sulu.
translations.idiomatic: The Turks and Tibet also gave him their daughters in marriage.

sentences.zh: 既以三國女為可敦，又分立數子為葉護，費用漸廣。

translations.literal: Since he had women of three states as katun, and also set up several sons as yabghu, his expenses gradually grew vast.
translations.idiomatic: With wives from three states as katun and several sons appointed yabghu, his expenses grew heavy.

sentences.zh: 先既不為積貯，晚年抄掠所得者，留不分之。

translations.literal: Since he had never accumulated stores, in his later years what he gained from raiding he kept and did not distribute.
translations.idiomatic: Having never accumulated stores, in his later years he kept what he gained from raiding and no longer distributed it.

sentences.zh: 又因風病，一手攣縮，其下諸部，心始攜貳。

translations.literal: Also because of wind illness one hand was contracted and shrunken; among his subordinate tribes hearts first turned divided in loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: Also afflicted with wind illness, one hand contracted; his tribes began to waver in loyalty.

sentences.zh: 有大首領莫賀達幹、都摩度兩部落，最為強盛。

translations.literal: There were two tribes of great chieftains, Mohedagan and Dumodu, the most powerful.
